row.evidence: Jasper's pricing page lists SCIM only in the Business column (Pro shows a dash) and Business is 'custom pricing'; the SCIM help article says 'This is specific to Business plans.'
row.notes: SCIM and SAML SSO are Business-only, and Business is Contact Sales with a 12-month commitment. Pro ($59/seat/mo billed yearly, $69 monthly) includes 1 seat; more than one user requires Business, so Business is also the team plan and price_multiplier is null. SCIM setup is done with Jasper support, who send an IdP-specific guide; the public SCIM endpoint, auth and attribute list are not documented. The Okta OIN and Entra gallery 'Jasper AI' apps are SAML-only, so Okta/Entra SCIM runs through the support-provided setup, not the catalogue app. Roles are assigned in Jasper's Directory page, not via IdP groups. Business-only REST API (X-API-Key or OAuth) can list and get users but not create or remove them.

plans.name: Pro
plans.price_text: $59/month per seat billed yearly or $69/month billed monthly; includes 1 seat
plans.notes: Single-seat plan: 'Need more than 1 user on Pro?' points to Business.

operations.notes: Docs say create, update and deactivate are automated; PUT vs PATCH is not specified.

roles.how: Roles are assigned by the IT Admin on Jasper's Directory page, not through IdP groups over SCIM.

limitations.text: SCIM is enabled through Jasper support (hey@jasper.ai), who provide a tailored setup guide per IdP; no self-serve token or public endpoint docs.
Role assignment is not supported through IdP groups over SCIM.
With multiple workspaces, IT admins must assign each user's workspace in Jasper.
The IT Admin must first be provisioned through SCIM and takes up a seat.

endpoints.purpose: Retrieve all users in the workspace (limit/page query parameters)

rate_limits.text: Per-workspace limits; the published table covers content endpoints (e.g. 105 or 200 RPM) and does not list /users.

limitations.text: The API reference documents only read endpoints for users; no create, update or remove user calls.

okta.notes: OIN 'Jasper AI' page marks only SAML as checked (read from page markup); SCIM, Create, Deactivate are unchecked. Jasper says Okta SCIM is set up with a support-provided guide.

entra.notes: Microsoft's tutorial covers SAML SSO only; no provisioning tutorial found.

fallbacks.notes: SCIM endpoint details are not public; they come in a support-provided guide.
